feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 June 2026 4:09pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 03 June 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure will track slowly eastwards across Scotland tonight, moving into the North Sea later tomorrow.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 5 or 6 this evening and at first tonight, occasionally 7 in a few places, mainly in the east of the area. Veering West or Southwest 5 or 6 later in the night, still occasionally 7 in east of the area, with little change thereafter.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, some heavy.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in the east, decreasing 4 or 5 later tomorrow night or at first. Backing South later on Friday morning and afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Occasional showers, soon becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.
